skill_name: Imagine you are writing a script for a movie. Describe the house of the main character.
workflow: The house of the main character was an old, Victorian-style house nestled between two large oak trees. To the left of the house was a tall gate - the entrance to the yard full of wildflowers and a large, shady maple tree.
